passive.name: Voices from the Void
passive.description: A voice warns Wraith when she's being targeted by an enemy at long range, when an enemy is aiming down sights at her, or when a trap has been set nearby.

tactical.name: Into the Void
tactical.description: Reposition quickly through the safety of the void, avoiding all damage. Wraith cannot use weapons or abilities while in the void.

ultimate.name: Dimensional Rift
ultimate.description: Link two locations with portals for 60 seconds, allowing the entire team to use them.

passive.name: Tracker
passive.description: See tracks left behind by enemies, revealing their recent movements.

tactical.name: Eye of the Allfather
tactical.description: Briefly reveal enemies, traps, and clues through all structures in front of you.

ultimate.name: Beast of the Hunt
ultimate.description: Heightened senses let you see cold tracks and move faster. Highlights enemies in red. Knockdowns extend the duration.

passive.name: Insider Knowledge
passive.description: Scan a Survey Beacon to reduce the cooldown of Zipline Gun.

tactical.name: Grappling Hook
tactical.description: Grapple to get to out-of-reach places quickly.

ultimate.name: Zipline Gun
ultimate.description: Create a zipline anyone can use.

passive.name: Combat Revive
passive.description: Lifeline's drone D.O.C. can revive teammates, freeing her to defend or revive someone else.

tactical.name: D.O.C. Heal Drone
tactical.description: Call your Drone of Compassion to automatically heal nearby teammates over time.

ultimate.name: Care Package
ultimate.description: Call in a drop pod full of high-quality defensive gear.

passive.name: Double Time
passive.description: Taking fire while sprinting makes you move faster for a brief time.

tactical.name: Smoke Launcher
tactical.description: Fire a high-velocity smoke canister that explodes into a smoke wall on impact.

ultimate.name: Rolling Thunder
ultimate.description: Call in an artillery strike that slowly creeps across the landscape.
